items.title: Motion to hold an Emergency Special Council Meeting
Declarations of Pecuniary Interest under the “Municipal Conflict of Interest Act”
Motion to go into Closed Session

motions.item_title: Motion to hold an Emergency Special Council Meeting
motions.text: That pursuant to section 8.7 of the Region of Waterloo’s Procedural By-law 22-051, an Emergency Special Council Meeting be held, without 48 hours notice, on March 6, 2025 at 3:45 p.m., for the purpose of holding a closed session regarding a labour relations issue.
motions.text_html: That pursuant to section 8.7 of the Region of Waterloo’s Procedural By-law 22-051, an Emergency Special Council Meeting be held, without 48 hours notice, on March 6, 2025 at 3:45 p.m., for the purpose of holding a closed session regarding a labour relations issue.

motions.item_title: Motion to go into Closed Session
motions.text: That a closed meeting of the Council be held on March 6, 2025 at 3:50 p.m. in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters: labour relations or employee negotiations related to a union.
motions.text_html:
That a closed meeting of the Council be held on March 6, 2025 at 3:50 p.m. in the Waterloo County Room, in accordance with Section 239 of the “Municipal Act, 2001”, for the purposes of considering the following subject matters:

  1. labour relations or employee negotiations related to a union.

motions.text: That the meeting adjourn at 3:50 p.m.
